user.title: Connect to Jev
user.description: Jev Autopilot asks TypeSafe Jev what each room needs and acts on the answer. Use the TypeSafe API directly, or OpenRouter with base URL `https://openrouter.ai/api` and model `typesafe/jev-1.13`.

data_description.model: Model name sent with each request.

reauth_confirm.title: Jev rejected the API key
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new API key. Rooms keep their settings.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: Leave the API key empty to keep the current one.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

data_description.preset: How sure Jev must be before a room acts. Used by every room that has no preset of its own; picking one on the room's preset select overrides it.
data_description.notify_services: Mobile app notify services. Locks and other confirm-tier devices are only proposed here, never switched directly.
data_description.confirm_threshold: Minimum probability before a confirm-tier action is even proposed.
data_description.daily_call_budget: Rooms pause when this many calls were made today. Jev charges per input token only.
data_description.patrol_minutes: Rooms also re-check on sensor changes (debounced 30 s).
data_description.brightness_levels: Comma-separated, ascending. Jev picks a point on this scale.
data_description.heating_levels: Comma-separated; `off` is allowed as the first value.
data_description.house_notes: Plain-language habits for the whole house, e.g. 'We sleep around 23:30; nobody likes bright light after 22:00.'

error.invalid_levels: Use at least two comma-separated numbers.

user.title: Add a room
user.description: Pick what this room controls and what it should look at. Devices under 'Ask first' are only ever proposed to your phone.

data_description.context_entities: Motion, occupancy, lux, temperature, door sensors. Changes trigger a re-check.
data_description.yield_automations: Turned off while the autopilot runs this room, turned back on when it stops or fails.
data_description.room_notes: Plain-language habits for this room, e.g. 'Desk work until 18:00, cosy light in the evening.'

error.no_entities: Select at least one device to control.
error.duplicate_entity: A device can only be in one list.
error.entity_in_other_room: This device already belongs to another room.

options.conservative: Conservative: acts only when very sure
options.aggressive: Aggressive: acts early, backs off fast

budget_reached.title: Jev Autopilot reached its daily budget
budget_reached.description: All rooms paused after {budget} calls today and your automations are in charge until midnight. Raise the budget in the integration options if this happens often.

room_degraded.title: Jev Autopilot handed {room} back
room_degraded.description: Three calls in a row failed ({error}). The replaced automations are running again. The room takes over by itself after the next successful call.
